title: Automatic Construction of Evaluation Suites for Natural Language Generation Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing natural language generation performance (using metrics like BLEURT) on data subsets from the ToTTo dataset that describe male versus female individuals.
Evaluating differences in model performance across subpopulation splits based on the nationality of the persons described in the input tables, grouped by continent.
Measuring disparities in generation quality by comparing model performance on a subset of data specifically describing African Americans against a subset representing all US citizens.
